source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The adjusted reland checks fileSize < 0 and returns NS_ERROR_FAILURE before constructing mozilla::Buffer. Preserve that guard when changing header parsing. A failed GetFileSize call is checked separately; a successful call with a negative result must not become an allocation size.
title: Reject negative file sizes before allocating the EML read buffer
